---
title: "Indice de Competencias"
---

Vista agregada por competencia con buscador y filtro por tags.

<div class="cp-controls">
  <input id="competition-search" type="search" placeholder="Buscar competencia..." />
  <select id="competition-tag">
    <option value="">Todos los tags</option>
  </select>
  <span id="competition-count" class="cp-count"></span>
</div>

<div id="competition-empty" class="cp-empty" style="display:none;">No hay competencias para los filtros actuales.</div>
<div id="competition-grid" class="cp-grid"></div>

<script>
(async function () {
  const response = await fetch("problems/catalog.json");
  const data = await response.json();

  const searchEl = document.getElementById("competition-search");
  const tagEl = document.getElementById("competition-tag");
  const gridEl = document.getElementById("competition-grid");
  const countEl = document.getElementById("competition-count");
  const emptyEl = document.getElementById("competition-empty");

  const tags = [...new Set(data.flatMap(item => item.tags || []))].sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b));
  for (const tag of tags) {
    const option = document.createElement("option");
    option.value = tag;
    option.textContent = tag;
    tagEl.appendChild(option);
  }

  const grouped = new Map();
  for (const item of data) {
    const key = item.competition;
    if (!grouped.has(key)) {
      grouped.set(key, {
        name: key,
        problems: [],
        tags: new Set(),
        solutions: 0,
      });
    }
    const entry = grouped.get(key);
    entry.problems.push(item);
    entry.solutions += item.solutions_count || 0;
    for (const tag of item.tags || []) {
      entry.tags.add(tag);
    }
  }

  function render() {
    const term = searchEl.value.trim().toLowerCase();
    const selectedTag = tagEl.value;

    const items = [...grouped.values()].filter(item => {
      const matchText = !term || item.name.toLowerCase().includes(term);
      const matchTag = !selectedTag || item.tags.has(selectedTag);
      return matchText && matchTag;
    }).sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name));

    gridEl.innerHTML = "";
    for (const item of items) {
      const tagsHtml = [...item.tags]
        .sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b))
        .slice(0, 8)
        .map(tag => `<span class="cp-tag">${tag}</span>`)
        .join(" ");

      const card = document.createElement("article");
      card.className = "cp-card";
      card.innerHTML = `
        <h3>${item.name}</h3>
        <p><strong>${item.problems.length}</strong> problema(s) · <strong>${item.solutions}</strong> solucion(es)</p>
        <p>${tagsHtml || "Sin tags"}</p>
        <p><a href="problemas.html?competition=${encodeURIComponent(item.name)}">Ver problemas de esta competencia</a></p>
      `;
      gridEl.appendChild(card);
    }

    countEl.textContent = `${items.length} competencia(s)`;
    emptyEl.style.display = items.length === 0 ? "block" : "none";
  }

  searchEl.addEventListener("input", render);
  tagEl.addEventListener("change", render);
  render();
})();
</script>
